Definition: from G220 and G5456; cock-crow, i.e. the third night-watch:--cockcrowing.
BiblicalUsage: Once, in the watch of the night. Jesus tells His disciples to watch, for they do not know when the master of the house comes, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning. The word is the third watch of the night, the hour before dawn when the cocks cry and the world is still dark.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for the cock's hour carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the command beside it, to watch, because the Master comes at an hour no one can name.
